# emobank_buechel_2017: Each sentence (`id`) was rated by about five annotators, but the source does not say which annotator gave which rating. So 255,231 of the 318,519 rows repeat a sentence and dimension (`item`), and 192,950 of those are identical to another row because two annotators gave the same rating. `id` is the sentence, not a person. Do not deduplicate.
emobank_buechel_2017

# VCISM_Polish_Trzcinska_2023: The source's child code (`id`) is reused. 9 codes each belong to 2 or 3 different children in the same wave, so 198 of the 2,070 rows repeat an id, item and wave (81 of them identical copies), and those ids mix responses from different children.
VCISM_Polish_Trzcinska_2023
# robison_2026_retesting_ifr: 8 of the 34,437 rows are exact copies of another row. They may come from restarted sessions, which have not yet been checked against the source.
robison_2026_retesting_ifr

# robison_2026_retesting_paper_folding: 6 participants repeat trial numbers within one session, which looks like a restarted session. 108 of the 8,980 rows repeat an id, item, wave and trial number: 47 are identical copies and 44 carry a different response.
robison_2026_retesting_paper_folding

# cud_stone2024: 5 patient ids each have two different records on the same date. 60 of the 71,108 rows repeat an id, item and date: 38 carry a different response and 22 are identical. The source does not show which record is right.
cud_stone2024
